comments.text:
What he actually said: 
He was born into a wealthy family, and he felt that his childhood went by very quickly. His daily routine started when the sun rose into the sky (aka it was morning time), and he got up super early too… but he didn’t have a job, so he went looking for one. His first job? He was working in a diner, serving food to customers because the manager was unable to serve all of those customers. However, the dude couldn’t seem to help out all too much, so he got fired (which means lost the job). So he went back to his tiny apartment, and he was frustrated with himself. However, he went out to get a different job, this time working on a farm to earn some money. He then flew off to Chicago in an airplane, and he met the loveliest woman he’d ever seen. It was love at first sight! (And that’s part 1)
